newsitem.title: USA: Decorator sets stock split, raises payout.
newsitem.headline: Decorator sets stock split, raises payout.

text.p: Decorator Industries Inc said Monday it declared a five-for-four stock split and raised its quarterly dividend by 25 percent.
The company said the stock split is effective on June 13 to stockholders of record on June 4.
Decorator also said its next quarterly cash dividend of $0.07 per share will be paid on post-split shares, with record and payable dates matching that of the stock split.
The dividend amount, which is the same as the company had paid on its pre-split shares, represents a 25 increase in the cash payout.
Decorator said it will have about three million shares outstanding after the split.
